item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00262","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C20","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 is a direct and material drafting precursor. It directs the Secretary of the Interior, in cooperation with the Secretary of the Navy, to develop plans and a specific schedule for the orderly transfer of Guam from naval to civilian administration, preferably within the next year. The child implements precisely that contemplated transfer through an approved Navy–Interior memorandum, fixes July 1, 1950 as the effective date, assigns civil administration to Interior, and requires interagency cooperation. C20 and C03 share narrower transfer machinery, but neither approaches C04's target-specific and procedural correspondence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"plans for the orderly transfer of administrative responsibility for the Island of Guam from the Secretary of the Navy to the Secretary of the Interior","parent_excerpt":"realistic planning be undertaken immediately to effectuate orderly transfer of the aforementioned islands from naval to civilian administration","explanation":"Both prescribe an orderly transition from Navy administration to civilian administration, with Interior taking the lead."},{"child_excerpt":"The Department of the Navy and the Department of the Interior shall proceed with the plans for the transfer ... as embodied in the above mentioned memorandum of understanding","parent_excerpt":"I request that you take the lead, in cooperation with the Secretary of the Navy, in developing a specific time schedule within which the desired transfers may be effected","explanation":"The child's joint departmental planning mechanism and schedule directly carry out the earlier instruction."},{"child_excerpt":"such transfer to become effective on July 1, 1950","parent_excerpt":"Preferably, under such a schedule, the Island of Guam should be transferred to civilian administration within the next year","explanation":"The effective date concretizes the parent directive's Guam-specific one-year timetable."},{"child_excerpt":"the Secretary of the Interior shall take such action as may be necessary and appropriate ... for the administration of civil government on the Island of Guam","parent_excerpt":"designate the Department of the Interior as the civilian agency with general supervision over civil administration of these islands","explanation":"The child converts the contemplated designation of Interior into an operative assignment of civil-government responsibility."}]}
